$comment: Dependency-direction rules for scripts/check-cross-package-boundaries.mjs. The server's internal module layers are enforced separately by check-module-boundaries.mjs.

rules.reason: UI data and utility layers must not depend on pages or components.
Components must not import page modules; pass data in through props or hooks.
Hooks must stay renderer-agnostic and must not import pages.
The API server must not import browser UI or CLI source.
The CLI talks to the API over HTTP and must not import server or UI source.
Shared packages must not depend on application source trees.
